messages.subject: size of home ranges
parts:
Dear All,

 

I have parsed my data set of goitered gazelles into year, season, year-season, and all locations.  I’ve calculated all home ranges for these filters.  My question is why are the home ranges of some of the subsets larger than the HR for all locations?  Thanks, Nanette.

 

Sent from Mail for Windows 10

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: size of home ranges
parts:
Hi Nanette,

This is either by random chance or because the movement behavior is changing in time. AKDE estimates a long-term prediction of space use, conditional on a particular suite of movement behaviors.

Best,
Chris
